# Preference Optimization

> Direct Preference Optimization built from scratch: a supervised reference policy, a Bradley-Terry preference dataset, and an exact, hand-derived DPO gradient that aligns the policy to the hidden reward.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization

## Source

- [src/preference_optimization/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/__init__.py): Preference Optimization - Direct Preference Optimization from scratch.
- [src/preference_optimization/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/cli.py): Command line interface for preference optimization.
- [src/preference_optimization/domain.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/domain.py): The alignment task: prompts, candidate responses, and a hidden gold reward.
- [src/preference_optimization/dpo.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/dpo.py): Direct Preference Optimization with an exact, hand-derived gradient.
- [src/preference_optimization/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/evaluation.py): Evaluation metrics for preference optimization.
- [src/preference_optimization/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/preference_optimization/pipeline.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/pipeline.py): The end-to-end alignment pipeline: build task, fit reference, run DPO, evaluate.
- [src/preference_optimization/policy.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/policy.py): A log-linear softmax policy over candidate responses.
- [src/preference_optimization/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the aligned policy.
- [src/preference_optimization/sft.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/preference-optimization/blob/main/src/preference_optimization/sft.py): Supervised fine-tuning by behavior cloning.
